problem:
Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the curves $y={e}^{x},$ $y=\operatorname{ln}⁡x,$  and the lines $y=1-x$  and $y=1+e-x.$ 
Express ${∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type I regions.

feedback.problem:
Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the curve $y=-6{x}^{2}+24x-17$ and lines $y=6x-5,$ $x=3,$ and $y=1.$
Express ${∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type I regions.
feedback.worked_solution:
First, let's sketch our region.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070962/assets/fe0209b3ed99aae4a1a939dfc7a8e0e400976809cc220abb1fbdf2f766c76171.png)

The region $D$ can be partitioned into two type I regions ${D}_{1}$ and ${D}_{2},$ as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070962/assets/c8ba7d6923e2e4ef9ee528c48a8f5664ec10e4f05a13dad941713600d93ddfe5.png)

As a result, we get

$$
{D}_{1}={(x,y)\,:\,1\le x\le 2,\,1\le y\le 6x-5}
$$

and 

$$
{D}_{2}={(x,y)\,:\,2\le x\le 3,\,1\le y\le -6{x}^{2}+24x-17}.
$$

Therefore, using the additivity property of double integrals, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA & ={∬}_{{D}_{1}}f(x,y)\,dA+{∬}_{{D}_{2}}f(x,y)\,dA \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{1}^{6x-5}f(x,y)\,dy\,dx+{\int }_{2}^{3}{\int }_{1}^{-6{x}^{2}+24x-17}f(x,y)\,dy\,dx.\end{aligned}
$$
